title: Projects UI
statement: The system shall let a user switch, create and delete projects from the web UI.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: The switcher lists projects with counts and switches via #/p/KEY
The create dialog validates the key and switches to the new project
The delete dialog requires typing the key and removes the project
Data and chat are isolated per project
